name: Libnah
overview: Libnah appears in Scripture as a significant location in Israel's history, serving both as a station during the wilderness journey and as a city within the tribal territory of Judah, which Joshua captured in battle. It was allotted to the priests, highlighting its role in the spiritual life of Israel. The city also figures in the account of Assyrian aggression, where Sennacherib's army besieged Libnah but was ultimately defeated, demonstrating God's protection over His people.
